title: This Animal Can Run 35 mph for Four Miles Straight

scenes.text: This animal can run 35 miles an hour for four miles straight.
It's the pronghorn of North America, and in a sprint it hits 55 miles an hour.
A cheetah is faster in a short burst, but it can't hold its top speed nearly as long.
Its secret is a huge windpipe, big lungs and a big heart, plus light bones and hollow hair.
A cheetah wins the sprint. The pronghorn wins the marathon.

description:
The pronghorn can hold 35 miles an hour for about four miles.
In a short sprint it reaches 55 miles an hour.
It has a huge windpipe, large lungs and heart, and very light bones.
Would you bet on the cheetah or the pronghorn in a long race?
first_comment: Cheetah or pronghorn: who wins a 4-mile race?
